material.goal: Establish the current evidence-backed state of cyberalchemy-orchestrator, separating implemented behavior from proposals, hypotheses, and open residue; then determine how the proposed recursive work orchestrator relates to the current control plane and what an honest integration contract with the private agent-reasoning-engine would require.
material.context: The target repository is frozen at b42228fcf4a5a6dadefbbfb53dfaa3c3edb28108 for tracked evidence, while docs/features/recursive-work-orchestrator is an untracked proposal-only source set with separately frozen SHA-256 identities. The target now contains a tracked workflow-graph discovery and autonomous-agent-graph target model, plus a substantial governed runtime, so older Inventory classifications must be revalidated rather than repeated. The private agent-reasoning-engine has a bounded promoted L0 semantic-evaluator witness but no whole-engine promotion or executable cross-repository binding. Research uses an exact-binding evidence contract and may recommend or kill integration seams, but it cannot edit either product, register target ACI bindings, promote authority, select implementation work, publish, deploy, or claim runtime behavior not directly observed or executed.
material.anti_bias_global: Implemented control-plane truth versus proposal and residue truth versus cross-owner semantic integration truth, followed by independent ownership, non-vacuity, and definitional attacks.

groups.anti_bias: Composite methodology and source-corpus axis: empirical current-code verification, historical and structural proposal analysis, and formal cross-owner contract mapping.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs empirical current-code and test verification while agent 1 runs historical-structural proposal and residue analysis on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a bias in agent 0 toward equating executable slices with the whole product would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward treating design prose as current behavior would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 derives the strongest implemented capability from current code and tests while agent 2 maps formal owner, data, command, event, gate, and reasoning contracts across repositories on the methodology axis; a bias in agent 0 toward local implementation sufficiency would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward elegant but unwitnessed integration would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 classifies proposal hypotheses and open questions within the recursive-work and workflow-graph corpora while agent 2 stress-tests which of those concepts may cross into the reasoning-engine boundary on the source-corpus and methodology axes; a bias in agent 1 toward architectural closure would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward forcing semantic-engine concerns into orchestration would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: Empirical current-code verification over the tracked cyberalchemy-orchestrator runtime, tests, migrations, CLI, and as-built evidence.
agents.initial_prompt: Work from /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core as a read-only research seat. The nested repository projects/cyberalchemy-orchestrator is a source corpus frozen at tracked commit b42228fcf4a5a6dadefbbfb53dfaa3c3edb28108; do not switch branches, edit it, invoke its target-owned ACI bridge, or create target workflow bindings. Audit the actually implemented state using current tracked code, migrations, CLIs, APIs, tests, implementations/README.md, and implementations/AS-BUILT.md. Build a capability matrix with: capability, exact source selector, exact test selector, whether you executed a check, proof status observed/executed/unverified, strongest supported claim, and explicit non-claim. Distinguish schema/fixture existence, tested local behavior, end-to-end local runtime, external effect, production, and proposal. Trace the current host workflow binding, dispatch workflow, journal, protocol compilation, reference delivery, Bus/reveal seams, APT projections, operator recovery, and Control Center only as far as evidence permits. Compare current bytes to the historical Inventory classification and identify precisely what changed, what became implemented, and what remains absent. Return a structured exact-binding research receipt and a concise narrative; make no file changes. Output target about 4200 tokens.

agents.angle: Historical-structural proposal analysis over the recursive-work proposal, workflow-graph discovery, autonomous-agent-graph target model, and their preserved residue.
agents.initial_prompt: Work from /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core as a read-only research seat. Treat projects/cyberalchemy-orchestrator/docs/features/recursive-work-orchestrator/DESIGN.md and ontology/ONTOLOGY.md as untracked proposal-only sources at the SHA-256 identities recorded in strategy-inventory-packet.json, not as repository implementation. agents.angle: Formal cross-owner integration mapping from recursive Work and current orchestrator primitives into the private agent-reasoning-engine layers without owner collapse.
agents.initial_prompt: Work from /home/vrondelli/projects/domainspec-core as a read-only research seat. Map the current cyberalchemy-orchestrator implementation and the proposal-only recursive Work model to cyberAlchemy-v2/development/agent-reasoning-engine and cyberAlchemy-v2/implementation/agent-reasoning-engine. Verify direct source bytes; Inventory is only a lead. Build two exact-binding matrices: (A) recursive-work concept -> current orchestrator implementation owner/witness/gap; (B) recursive-work or orchestrator output -> agent-reasoning-engine entry gate, intent projection, actor/ACI journal, bounded L0 semantic evaluator, challenge/admissibility, exact-effect candidate, replay/revalidation, and later L1-L3 boundaries. For every proposed connection name producer, consumer, immutable identity, payload or artifact, authority owner, lifecycle owner, semantic owner, gate, failure behavior, replay rule, evidence status, and forbidden substitution. Determine whether the reasoning engine should be a leaf Work adapter, a composite Work body, a gate-adjacent evaluator, a sidecar, or none of those; select, narrow, or KILL each option with a finite witness or counterexample. Preserve that orchestration/routing is not semantic judgment, evaluator positivity is non-authorizing, and ACI/effect ownership cannot be duplicated. Include the target host-binding rule as an integration surface, not authorization for this parent-owned research dispatch. Return exact selectors, proof statuses, open owner decisions, and the smallest documentation-only integration contract that could safely precede implementation; make no file changes. Output target about 4600 tokens.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into one evidence-bounded current-state and integration model. Do not average disagreements: preserve separate tracked implementation, untracked proposal, tracked discovery/target hypothesis, and private reasoning-engine evidence columns. Produce: (1) current project capability map by proof tier; (2) proposals, hypotheses, decisions, non-decisions, blockers, and open questions; (3) deltas from the prior Inventory classification; (4) exact current-implementation-to-recursive-work mapping; (5) exact recursive-work/orchestrator-to-agent-reasoning-engine mapping; (6) candidate integration topologies with SELECT, NARROW, DEFER, MERGE, or KILL verdicts; (7) a smallest safe documentation-only integration contract and recomposition path; (8) negative controls for nested scheduler authority, journal/semantic-owner collapse, routing-as-reasoning, result-as-authorization, proposal-as-implementation, and target-host-binding spoofing; and (9) a residue ledger with owner and required evidence. Every load-bearing row must include immutable source identity, exact selector or structured pointer, explorer-return reference, evidence scope, and observed/executed/unverified status. Return only synthesis and a structured receipt; do not write repository files. Output target about 5200 tokens.

groups.anti_bias: Attack-vector axis: precedent and owner duplication, non-vacuity and finite integration witness, and definitional plus authority non-collapse.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks owner duplication and unsupported novelty through direct current precedents while agent 1 attacks vacuity through finite executable or paper-executable witnesses on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward classifying ownership without proving usefulness would be exposed by agent 1, while a bias in agent 1 toward a bespoke working story that duplicates an owner would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 0 classifies existing owners and reuse obligations while agent 2 attacks definitional and authority collapse on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 0 toward reusing an existing surface under the wrong meaning would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward rejecting compatible reuse because names differ would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 requires finite end-to-end discriminating witnesses while agent 2 requires every stage to preserve distinct routing, lifecycle, semantic, evidence, and effect authority on the attack-vector axis; a bias in agent 1 toward a persuasive but authority-collapsing flow would be exposed by agent 2, while a bias in agent 2 toward a perfectly separated but operationally empty taxonomy would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: locate the actual owner for each proposed orchestration, workflow, semantic-evaluation, journal, gate, effect, and projection responsibility.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only precedent, ownership, and duplication in the synthesized current-state and integration model. Verify direct current sources rather than Inventory summaries. For every proposed component or seam, identify the existing owner or record precedent-clean only after an actual bounded search across cyberalchemy-orchestrator implementation and plans, recursive-work sources, ACI/Bus/APT contracts named by the sources, and the agent-reasoning-engine architecture and implementation. Classify build-from-owned, already-implemented, proposal-only, owner-conflict, or genuinely unowned; being owned is never itself a KILL. Return PASS or exact repairs with current selectors, source identities, and owner consequences. Make no file changes. Output target about 2800 tokens.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: force each current-state and integration claim through finite positive, negative, retry, replay, and blocked-path witnesses.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only non-vacuity. Select representative paths that discriminate among implemented capability, proposal, and integration hypothesis: confirmed dispatch to bound host seat and journal; recursive Work sequence plus gate; fan-out/fan-in plus sidecar and bounded retry; reasoning entry block with zero evaluator calls; positive bounded L0 semantic result that still cannot effect; replay and current revalidation; and a cross-repository seam with missing owner receipt. For each, require an exact step table and name which current code/test executes it, which step is paper-only, which expected invariant fails, and which proposed integration would change the answer. KILL any claim or seam that has no distinct witness or counterexample. Return PASS or exact repairs; do not run destructive or external-effect checks and make no file changes. Output target about 3000 tokens.

agents.angle: Definitional and authority gate: prevent workflow graph, recursive Work, ACI runtime, semantic evaluator, evidence projection, and reasoning engine from collapsing into one owner or one claim.
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only definitional soundness and authority non-collapse. Test every synthesis noun and edge against these distinctions: WorkDefinition/WorkRun; graph definition/run plan/accepted history/routing cursor/domain status; root orchestrator/composite work; command/event; transport/persistence/decision/execution; dispatch confirmation/domain gate/semantic verdict/exact-effect eligibility; actor protocol/semantic evaluator; evidence/authority; observation/claim; retry/revalidation/replay; and target ACI host binding/parent research governance. Require a unique meaning, owner, input, output, failure mode, and forbidden substitution for each retained term. Return KEEP, MERGE, RENAME, DEFER, or KILL plus PASS only if the smallest repaired vocabulary remains operationally non-vacuous. Make no file changes. Output target about 3000 tokens.

Write only ops/development/2026-08-04-cyberalchemy-orchestrator-rwo-are-current-state-research/findings.md from the evidence-closed synthesis and reviewer receipts. Lead with the strongest current-state answer in plain language. Then include separate sections for tracked implemented state, tested versus merely present surfaces, untracked proposal-only recursive-work state, tracked workflow-graph and autonomous-agent-graph hypotheses, current deltas from prior research, complete open-question and blocker residue, an exact implementation-to-recursive-work matrix, an exact recursive-work/orchestrator-to-agent-reasoning-engine matrix, selected/narrowed/deferred/killed integration topologies, a smallest safe documentation-only integration contract, negative controls, validation still required, and a verdict matrix for precedent/non-vacuity/definitional soundness. Every load-bearing claim must cite the explorer return and direct exact source selector, label observed/executed/unverified status, and preserve private/public and authority boundaries. State that the research does not implement, authorize, select, promote, publish, deploy, or prove production readiness. Do not edit any other file. Output target about 5600 tokens.

Audit findings.md only against the frozen goal, exact-binding closure matrix, direct sources, and reviewer verdicts. Require a precise current-state answer; explicit separation of implemented/tested/proposal/hypothesis/open residue; accurate treatment of the untracked recursive-work sources and tracked workflow-graph discovery; exact mapping to current orchestrator code and the bounded L0 agent-reasoning-engine witness; owner-preserving integration topology; complete blockers and open questions; no routing-as-reasoning, nested scheduler, journal-as-semantic-owner, verdict-as-authorization, proposal-as-implementation, target-host-binding spoof, publication, deployment, or production inflation; and a complete verdict matrix.
